TAL_BRUTE_FOLLOW_THROUGH.why: Automated (combat/ext/lane4_brute.py): a Bonus Action copy of the character's own Brutal Shove that can only be aimed at a creature it just damaged with a melee weapon attack this turn.

TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_COMBO_MANEUVERS.why: Automated (combat/ext/lane4_dual.py): the off-hand attack can be traded for the unarmed Shove or Grapple options ('Combo Maneuvers: ...'), spending the same off-hand slot.

tianxia.talent.equipment.sure_harness.why: Nothing to ignore: this table never reads an armor's Strength requirement, so no armor ever reduces Speed for missing it.

LIFE_BASE_LIFE_INITIATION.why: Recognising signs of injury and illness, and using the Life key ability for Medicine checks made to stabilise or identify a wound; a fight has no Medicine-check action for it to change.

tianxia.talent.beauty.unforgettable_face.why: A creature that failed a Beauty save remembers the character for a year (or the emotion it left); a memory, with no hit points, condition or roll in a fight.

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SOMNAMBULANCE.why: Natural sleep during a Long Rest does not cost Martial Focus and Passive Perception keeps working; a fight has no natural sleep.

TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_ROOTED_WITNESS_GROVE.why: An Action to touch a Living Claim and ask what passed near it (creatures, blood, fire, lies, spirits); an investigation answer from the GM, with no effect on a fight.

tianxia.talent.talismans.heavenly_seal.why: The text says it outright: a Heavenly Seal is a project (30 days, 10,000 gp, GM approval), not a normal combat action.
